verdict.rationale: Jules' API explicitly supports sending a message to an active agent session and approving/adjusting plans mid-task (jules-docs-12, jules-docs-17), and the product notifies users when a task needs input (jules-docs-6), which together evidence the core follow-up-instruction capability. However, community feedback notes Jules can get stuck in loops with no quick way to interrupt or redirect it (jules-comm-14), suggesting steering is not always reliable in practice. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of mid-session message semantics/behavior, examples of successful steering outcomes, and independent hands-on confirmation that follow-ups reliably redirect an in-progress session.
